I’m grateful to the voters of CA-15 for tonight’s primary election results and I look forward to vigorously campaigning for re-election in the fall. A seat in the U.S. House of Representatives belongs to the people- not any one member. As such, I never take any election for granted and I plan to earn every vote based upon my record of service delivering results for CA-15, defending our democracy under threat from an authoritarian Trump administration, making our communities more resilient for what is to come with climate change, and pushing for an affordable economy that works for everyone.  In addition to running for re-election, I look forward to helping elect Democrats across California and the nation in 2026 so we may take control of the House and be a check on Trump and MAGA extremism and preserve our democratic republic for future generations.

At the start of the 119th Congress, Kevin was appointed to be Co-chair of the Congressional Taskforce on Strengthening Democracy. In this role, he’s able to conduct oversight into the Trump administration’s executive overreach, lead initiatives to modernize the federal government, fight back against corruption, and expand access to the ballot box.
​
Now, more than ever, Kevin is focused on protecting core American freedoms, defending our democracy, and safeguarding the electoral process from those who ignore the will of the people and the rule of law.

# Kevin's Accomplishments
In 2022, Congressman Kevin Mullin was elected to represent California’s 15th Congressional District (CA-15) in the U.S. House of Representatives. While in Congress, Kevin has been an outspoken leader in addressing America’s high cost of living, mitigating the impacts of climate change, strengthening our democratic institutions, protecting California’s innovation economy, and maintaining U.S. leadership in medical research.
​
Since being elected to Congress, Kevin has cosponsored 943 bills. Kevin’s consideration for supporting these bills requires thoughtful evaluation, research, and consulting with his constituents in CA-15.
​
Kevin has also introduced 24 bills during his first three years in Congress, many of them bipartisan, common sense solutions to real life challenges that his constituents have brought to his attention. Some of these bills include:

Creates a grant for low-income homeowners and affordable housing providers to make their property more resilient to climate-driven disasters.

### Poverty Line Act

## Editorial Boards
# The Examiner endorses Mullin for re-election
California’s 15th Congressional District — which runs along the San Francisco Peninsula through much of San Mateo County and into the southeastern corner of The City — is not a flashy district. It doesn’t generate the national headlines that some of its neighbors do.
​
What it needs is a representative who shows up, knows the district’s communities and delivers. Mullin does that. The Examiner Editorial Board endorses him for reelection.
​
Mullin came to Congress in 2022, succeeding the long-serving Jackie Speier after 10 years in the California State Assembly, where he served as speaker pro tempore. He arrived in Washington, D.C., already fluent in the machinery of legislation — a significant advantage in a chamber in which new members often spend their first term finding their footing.
​
After just two years in Congress, House Democratic leadership appointed him to the influential House Energy and Commerce Committee, where he serves on the Energy Subcommittee and the Commerce, Manufacturing and Trade Subcommittee — one of the most consequential assignments in the House for a district that sits at the intersection of the Bay Area’s technology economy and its clean energy future. He has also been appointed co-chair of the Congressional Task Force on Strengthening Democracy.
​
The 15th District deserves a representative who knows its needs and has the seniority and committee assignments to address them. Mullin has earned a second term.
​
The Examiner Editorial Board endorses Kevin Mullin for U.S. House District 15.
